title: Qt: Remove redundant ManageInterfacesDialog signal
description:
The ManageInterfacesDialog sends a ifsChanged signal when closed,
which the CaptureOptionsDialog listens for to refresh its list and
also emit so that the InterfaceFrame will refresh its list. However,
the ManageInterfacesDialog already requests the InterfaceListManager
refresh the interfaces, and that refresh results in the
CaptureOptionsDialog and InterfaceFrame refreshing their list upon
completion anyway. Remove the unnecessary signal, which only causes
extra GUI updates that in some case are too early, before the refresh
has completed. Remove a handful of other signals that are also now
unneeded.

Tested to work when adding remote rpcapd interfaces, which is one of
the primary use cases for the dialog.

Ping #21318
